Context: 9. Relaxations / Concessions in Promotions.-

- (iii) Departmental qualifying examination.Suitable relaxation in the qualifying standard in such examinations should be made in the case of SC/ST candidates.
- (iv) Seniority.SC/ST Government servants shall, on their promotion by virtue of rule of reservation/ roster, be entitled to consequential seniority also. - Order 37, Section 2.
